one_line_answer.text: Assessment may be carried out for a number of purposes, such as certification or diagnosis.

cites.quote: Assessment may be carried out for a number of purposes such as:
Certification/Qualification
Diagnosis

keywords.bn: কর্মীর স্তর বা লেভেল ঠিক করা

bangla_explanation: Assessment শুধু সার্টিফিকেট দেওয়ার জন্য নয়, এর অনেক purposes আছে।
Diagnosis দিয়ে learner-এর literacy আর numeracy-র needs বোঝা যায়।
Recruitment, training needs, employee classification-এও assessment লাগে।
Assessment-এর আগে উদ্দেশ্য পরিষ্কার না হলে ভুল জিনিস মাপা হতে পারে।

example.en: A garments factory assesses applicants for a machine operator post. This is assessment for recruitment.
example.bn: মেশিন অপারেটর পদে লোক নিতে assessment করা হলো recruitment-এর purpose।

items.text: Certification/Qualification: assessed against competency standards to be issued a formal qualification.

cites.quote: Individuals can be assessed against competency standards, to identify if they meet all the requirements and thus be issued with a formal qualification.

items.text: Diagnosis: determine learner's needs, especially in literacy and numeracy.

cites.quote: Diagnostic assessment is commonly used to determine learner's needs especially in relation to literacy and numeracy.

items.text: Recruitment: recruit a person for a particular job or job position.

cites.quote: Assessment may be carried out in order to recruit a person for a particular job or job position.

items.text: Education and training needs: identify training needs of employees.

cites.quote: Education and training needs.
Assessment can be used to identify training needs of employees.

items.text: Employee classification: employees move from one level to another.

cites.quote: Employee classification
Industries may use competency standards for employees to move from one level to another.

items.text: Assurance of progress: provide feedback to trainees over a period of learning.

cites.quote: Assurance of progress
Assessment can provide feedback to trainees over a period of learning.

items.text: Recognition of prior learning (RPL): recognise competencies gained through formal or informal learning.

cites.quote: Recognition of prior learning (RPL)
People may already possess various competencies gained through formal or informal learning and experiences and these may be recognized using an RPL process.

traps.text: Diagnosis is about learner's needs. Education and training needs is about employees' training needs.

cites.quote: Diagnostic assessment is commonly used to determine learner's needs
Assessment can be used to identify training needs of employees.

traps.text: NTVQF uses National Certificate levels one to six. There are also two prevocational levels.

cites.quote: In Bangladesh our NTVQF uses National Certificate levels one to six to describe the levels of qualification.
In addition, we have two prevocational levels.

short.prompt: List the purposes for which assessment may be carried out.
short.modelAnswer:
Assessment may be carried out for a number of purposes:
1. Certification/Qualification
2. Diagnosis (learner's literacy and numeracy needs)
3. Recruitment
4. Education and training needs
5. Employee classification
6. Assurance of progress
7. Recognition of prior learning (RPL)

keyPoints.text: Recruitment criteria are generally stated as selection criteria for the interview.

cites.quote: The criteria for the position are generally stated as selection criteria and form the basis of the interview.

keyPoints.text: Training needs results can be used to design relevant training programs.

cites.quote: This can be used to design relevant training programs.

keyPoints.text: Progress results can modify how a training program is delivered.

cites.quote: assessment results can be used to modify the way in which a training program is delivered
